title: Starbuds Commerce City NOW OPEN!
excerpt: We're happy to announce that we've opened our eighth location in Commerce City, located at 5844 Dahlia St.,Commerce City, CO. We will be holding a Grand Opening Day in the next few weeks…

blocks.html: We're happy to announce that we've opened our eighth location in Commerce City, located at 5844 Dahlia St.,Commerce City, CO. We will be holding a Grand Opening Day in the next few weeks that will include vendors, ribbon cutting, food, fun & much more. Our hours are 8AM-10PM DAILY, so make sure you stop by and check it out!
We look forward to seeing you!
